text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The Twinkle Series will "evolve."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Records achieved in the past
will be rewritten by someone in the future—
and repeating that cycle has kept us moving forward and onward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Take the Classic Triple Crown, for example.
The Satsuki Sho, the Tokyo Yushun, and the Kikuka Sho.
The very first one to win them all was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
St. Lite.
Her record became a standard—
a new goal for the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The process of challenging and equaling that record... leads to the next great achievement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf, the "Emperor." The first Umamusume in history
to achieve an undefeated Classic Triple Crown.
On top of that, her greatest achievement was――

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—The first ever to achieve 7 Turf GⅠ victories.
Just how monumental this win count is...
the entire history of racing up to today speaks for itself.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Course records broken, historic first victories, consecutive titles... Ever since "The Emperor" achieved seven turf GⅠ wins, countless records have been made, broken... and rewritten.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, 7 Turf GⅠ victories—while some have matched it,
no one has yet gone beyond.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. Having achieved seven crowns but failed
to go beyond that, I couldn't possibly understand."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"‘However—an Umamusume capable of achieving it
would surely know naturally.’"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So answered the great Umamusume.
Then... what would an Umamusume capable of achieving it say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just become stronger than anyone else"?
"Run longer than anyone else"? "Make luck your ally"?
...After daydreaming about various answers, she shook her head.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—No answer seemed quite right.
To that question clinging to the corner of my mind...
one day, a vivid and wonderfully light ray of hope shone through.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know the way.
I really don't know."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“Still, looking at it the other way...
why would you think you can't do it in the first place?”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Just fight with all your might and make sure you win.
Do that eight times.
Seven wins or eight wins—it's all the same."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Almond Eye.
A spirited Umamusume whose eyes hold the overflowing
potential to make any dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Holding big dreams for the future she would forge—
I officially signed a contract to become her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since signing a contract with her...
and the date for her Debut race in the
Twinkle Series has finally been set.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: "It's finally time...! I can finally run in the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this official, Trainer!
So... what should we start with first?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huff... huff...!
...Phew!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: First, I tested her current abilities. It was to create the optimal training menu for her Make Debut, but—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"...That's 15 sets!
Next is the core strength test."
choice_data_list: (Cleared it with ease... What incredible strength)
(Cleared it with ease... What incredible strength!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
――If I were number 12,
I'd run up front in second place!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"And make your move just before the 3rd corner.
With how the race has unfolded so far, things are crowded along the inner rail, so—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And as for the all-important run itself—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hmph...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She runs with long, sweeping strides, using her whole body with great flexibility.
Furthermore, her burst of speed at critical moments is incredible—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
—Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Extending relentlessly on and on, as if bound by no limits...
She possesses an extraordinarily sharp turn of foot.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: “—So, did my abilities live up to your expectations?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The test results were all top-notch.
Everything about her is first-class—she holds the potential to make any dream come true.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: To win, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a moment's hesitation, she answered.
Her gaze straight ahead—her eyes brimmed with dreams.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'll win the race right in front of me!
No matter who my opponent is, I'll win!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—To definitely win!
That's my dream!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The most wonderful thing about Almond Eye.
It's neither her superb ability nor her raw talent.
It is—her unyielding will to win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it's to win, she'll spare no effort.
If her rival is overseas,
she won't hesitate to fly right over...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —And you?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: What is your dream?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fixed by her piercing stare, my thoughts momentarily froze.
The light dwelling in her eyes... glowed red in the sunset.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It shines forth.
The hope I held in my chest the day I signed a contract with her—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Just how far will her will to win—stronger than anyone else's—reach?
Expectations for the future begin to shine brightly...!"
choice_data_list: My dream is—for you to win.
My dream is— for you to win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I want to see for myself what kind of future
lies beyond all those piled-up victories...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
I see.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Your dream
is me, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Very well, I'll grant it!
In return, you must never lose either!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You're going to put together a training menu now, right?
I'm sure you won't stop until you're completely satisfied with it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: You're someone who hates losing to yourself, after all. That's why I chose you.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —Don't give up from here on out. Don't compromise.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Will you swear it on your own heart?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
I have high expectations for you!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then next is...
your turn!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"It wouldn't be fair if I were the only one making vows, would it?
Do you have anything you want to ask of me?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "...I think it over. On the path I walk with her... many things will surely happen. Whenever they do, I want to convey my feelings to her properly."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believing that even the slightest words...
can become her strength.
choice_data_list: Show me a sight I've never seen before.
Show me a sight I've never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Believing that even the slightest words...
can become her strength.
choice_data_list: Show me a sight I've never seen before.
Show me a sight I've never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I don't know if we'll
ever make it that far, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Beyond where I run, there's sure to be
something that will make your heart race!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Well, why don't we
head back before it gets dark—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...?
Is that your wish for me?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
It's weird, veeeery weird!
But... alright, I'll keep that in mind!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Well, why don't we
head back before it gets dark—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I don't know how long
"forever" really is, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, I look forward to working with you!
I'm eager to see you in action.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Well, why don't we
head back before it gets dark—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: That just now was—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Fly as far as you can!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The butterfly flutters its wings in the evening sun—
heading toward an endlessly expanding future.
